# GitHub repository profile

This document is the version-controlled source of truth for the public GitHub profile of `VitoMilanese/BadWolfQuiz`.

It covers repository metadata and the social preview only. README improvements belong to #390, and licensing belongs to #391.

## Repository description

Use this description in the repository **About** section:

> Self-hosted real-time quiz platform for creating and running multimedia Jeopardy-style games with ASP.NET Core, SignalR, Razor Pages, and SQLite.

Do not describe the project as open source until #391 adds an explicit license.

## Homepage

Set the repository website/homepage to:

`https://badwolf.buzz`

## Topics

Use this focused topic set:

- `quiz`
- `trivia`
- `jeopardy`
- `self-hosted`
- `aspnet-core`
- `dotnet`
- `signalr`
- `razor-pages`
- `realtime`
- `game`

These topics intentionally cover the product category, self-hosting angle, and primary technology stack without turning the topic list into a broad keyword dump.

## Social preview

The repository social-preview source image is:

`.github/social-preview.png`

Properties:

- 1280 × 640 pixels;
- PNG with a solid background;
- under 1 MB;
- uses the same black/red Bad Wolf visual language as the application's site social preview;
- keeps the wolf mark, `BAD WOLF QUIZ` branding, `PLAY | HOST | CREATE`, and `badwolf.buzz` readable at link-preview sizes.

GitHub recommends 1280 × 640 for best social-preview rendering. See [Customizing your repository's social media preview](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/customizing-your-repositorys-social-media-preview).

## Applying the profile on GitHub

After this file and `.github/social-preview.png` are on `main`:

1. On the repository main page, edit the **About** section and apply the description, homepage, and topics above.
2. Open **Settings** → **General** → **Social preview** → **Edit**.
3. Upload `.github/social-preview.png`.
4. Verify the repository main page shows the expected description, website, and topics.
5. Share the repository URL in a preview-capable surface and confirm the Bad Wolf social image is used.
